steps.title: Culture and transfect HEK293T cells
steps.instruction: Grow HEK293T cells in DMEM + 10 % FBS at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂. Passage cells at 80‑100 % confluence (300 × g, 5 min). Seed cells at 20 % confluency in 6‑well plates 24 h before transfection to reach 80‑90 % confluence. Transfect with PEI MAX 40000: mix 150 µL Opti‑MEM with 10 µL PEI, incubate 5 min; add 2 µg gRNA plasmid, incubate 15 min; add mixture to cells. Harvest cells 24–48 h post‑transfection.

steps.title: Extract total RNA with TRIzol
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL TRIzol to one well, scrape cells, stand 5 min RT. Add 200 µL chloroform, vortex, incubate 3 min RT, centrifuge 16,000 × g, 5 min, 4 °C. Transfer aqueous phase, add 500 µL isopropanol, incubate 10 min RT, centrifuge 16,000 × g, 15 min, 4 °C. Wash pellet with 1 mL 70 % ethanol, centrifuge 16,000 × g, 5 min, 4 °C. Air‑dry, resuspend in 40 µL ddH₂O.

steps.title: DNase treatment and phenol extraction
steps.instruction: Add 5 µL 10× DNase I buffer and 5 µL DNase I, incubate 37 °C, 1 h. Add 350 µL G50 buffer, then equal volume phenol:chloroform:isoamyl alcohol (25:24:1), shake vigorously, centrifuge 16,000 × g, 3 min, 4 °C. Transfer supernatant, add 2 µL 20 mg/mL glycogen and 1 mL 100 % ethanol, vortex, centrifuge 16,000 × g, 20 min, 4 °C. Wash pellet with 1 mL 70 % ethanol, centrifuge 16,000 × g, 5 min, 4 °C. Air‑dry 5 min, resuspend in 500 µL dT‑lysis/binding buffer.

steps.title: Ethanol precipitate RNA
steps.instruction: (Handled in previous step – pellet resuspended in 500 µL dT‑lysis/binding buffer).

steps.title: Capture poly(A) RNA with Oligo(dT) beads
steps.instruction: Equilibrate 25 µL Oligo(dT)25 magnetic beads in 500 µL dT‑lysis/binding buffer on magnetic rack, discard buffer. Add RNA sample to beads, incubate 10 min RT with agitation. Place on magnet, discard supernatant. Wash beads twice with 500 µL dT‑wash buffer 1 (1 min agitation each), once with 500 µL dT‑wash buffer 2, and once with 500 µL low‑salt buffer, magnetizing and discarding supernatant each time.

steps.title: Elute poly(A)+ RNA
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL dT‑elution buffer, vortex gently, incubate 50 °C, 2 min with occasional agitation. Magnetize, transfer eluate to new tube. Repeat elution once more with fresh 200 µL dT‑elution buffer and combine eluates.

steps.title: Optional pause of RNA sample
steps.instruction: Store eluted poly(A)+ RNA at –20 °C overnight if needed.

steps.title: Phenol extraction to remove beads
steps.instruction: Perform phenol extraction as in steps 3‑4, but replace G50 buffer with 1/10 volume 3 M NaOAc (40 µL per tube). Follow identical vortex, centrifugation, ethanol precipitation, and wash steps to obtain bead‑free RNA.

steps.title: Fragment RNA and dephosphorylate
steps.instruction: Dilute RNA in 1× shatter buffer on ice: 5 µL 5× RNA shatter buffer + 20 µL RNA + ddH₂O to 25 µL. Heat 95 °C, 120 s, then slam on ice. Add 25 µL ice‑cold 2× Stop/PNK buffer, then 2.5 µL T4 PNK; incubate 37 °C (lid 40 °C) 30 min. Add 5 µL 10× FastAP buffer, 5 µL FastAP enzyme, 37.5 µL ddH₂O; incubate 37 °C (lid 40 °C) 15 min.

steps.title: First RNA cleanup with MyONE silane beads
steps.instruction: Place 20 µL MyONE silane beads in 1.5 mL tube, magnetize, discard supernatant. Wash once with 900 µL RLT buffer. Resuspend beads in 300 µL RLT buffer. Add 300 µL RLT (3 vol) to RNA, mix; add 10 µL 5 M NaCl (1/10 vol) and 615 µL 95‑100 % ethanol (final 1.5 vol). Rotate 15 min RT, mixing every 5 min. Magnetize, discard supernatant. Wash beads with 1 mL 75 % ethanol, transfer to new tube; repeat wash twice more (30 s each). Air‑dry beads 5 min. Elute RNA with 30 µL ddH₂O, incubate 5 min RT, magnetize. Transfer 18 µL to a new tube (+CMC) and 12 µL to another tube (‑CMC).

steps.title: Divide sample into CMC+ and CMC-
steps.instruction: Already performed in previous step: 18 µL (+CMC) and 12 µL (‑CMC) transferred to separate tubes.

steps.title: CMC treatment and precipitation (first)
steps.instruction: Preheat thermocycler to 80 °C (lid on). Add 2.9 µL 40 mM EDTA to each tube, heat 3 min 80 °C, then ice. Add 100 µL 40 mM CMC in BEU buffer to +CMC tube; add 100 µL BEU buffer alone to –CMC tube. Incubate 40 °C, 45 min, 1,000 rpm on Thermomixer. Add 2 µL glycogen, 50 µL 3 M NaOAc, 1 mL ethanol; precipitate overnight –20 °C (or ≥30 min –80 °C). Centrifuge max speed 16,000 × g, 30 min, 4 °C. Wash pellet twice with 500 µL ice‑cold 70 % ethanol, centrifuge 16,000 × g, 10 min, 4 °C each. Air‑dry 2 min RT, resuspend each pellet in 30 µL sodium carbonate buffer.

steps.title: Incubate in sodium carbonate buffer
steps.instruction: Incubate both resuspended samples at 50 °C, 2 h, 1,000 rpm on Thermomixer.

steps.title: Second precipitation after carbonate incubation
steps.instruction: Add 2 µL glycogen, 3.33 µL 3 M NaOAc, 88 µL ethanol to each sample; precipitate overnight –20 °C (or ≥30 min –80 °C). Centrifuge max speed 16,000 × g, 30 min, 4 °C. Wash twice with 500 µL ice‑cold 70 % ethanol, centrifuge 16,000 × g, 10 min, 4 °C each. Air‑dry 2 min RT (cap open). Resuspend each pellet in 12.5 µL water.

steps.title: Optional pause before PAGE
steps.instruction: Store CMC‑treated and untreated RNA at –20 °C overnight if desired.

steps.title: First PAGE purification of RNA fragments
steps.instruction: Wash Owl system plates, spacers, combs with 5 % SDS, dry, then 95 % ethanol. Cast 8 % acrylamide gel with 7 M urea in 0.5× TBE. Pre‑run gel with aluminum heat sink to 55 °C, ~1 h total. Prepare fresh 2× RNA loading dye (95 % formamide). Dilute 10 bp ladder: 0.125 µL ladder + 12.375 µL water. Add 12.5 µL 2× loading dye to each RNA sample and ladder. Heat 95 °C 1 min, ice. Load samples, use syringe to blow out wells, run until xylene cyanol reaches near bottom. Disassemble, stain gel 5 min in 1:10,000 SYBR Gold in 0.5× TBE. Excise 10–20 nt bands (80‑100, 100‑120, 120‑140). Place slices in 0.6 mL microfuge tubes.

steps.title: Gel extraction and ethanol precipitation
steps.instruction: Pierce each tube with 20‑gauge needle, place into 1.5 mL tube, spin max speed 1 min; add 360 µL ddH₂O and 40 µL 3 M NaOAc, freeze –80 °C (or dry ice), thaw, rotate overnight at 55 °C. Spin down gel fragments, transfer supernatant to Bio‑Rad Micro‑Bio‑Spin column, spin 1,000 × g, 2 min. Add 1 µL glycogen and 1 mL ethanol, precipitate overnight –20 °C (or ≥30 min –80 °C). Centrifuge max speed 30 min, 4 °C. Wash twice with 500 µL ice‑cold 70 % ethanol, centrifuge 10 min, 4 °C each. Air‑dry 2 min RT, resuspend in 10.5 µL ddH₂O.

steps.title: 3′ RNA linker ligation
steps.instruction: In PCR tube combine: 10 µL RNA, 3 µL 100 % DMSO, 1 µL 3′ RNA linker (RiL19, 40 µL stock). Heat 65 °C 2 min, ice ≥1 min. Prepare 26 µL ligation master mix per sample: 4 µL 10× NEB ligase buffer, 0.4 µL 0.1 M ATP, 0.6 µL 100 % DMSO, 16 µL 50 % PEG 8000, 2.6 µL T4 RNA ligase 1, 1.1 µL ddH₂O. Add master mix to RNA, mix, incubate 75 min at RT, flicking tube every ~15 min.

steps.title: Second RNA cleanup with MyONE silane beads
steps.instruction: Place 20 µL MyONE silane beads in 1.5 mL tube, magnetize, discard supernatant. Wash once with 900 µL RLT buffer. Resuspend beads in 120 µL RLT buffer. Add 120 µL RLT (3 vol) to ligation reaction, mix. Add 120 µL 95‑100 % ethanol, mix, incubate RT 15 min, mixing every 5 min. Magnetize, discard supernatant. Wash beads with 1 mL 75 % ethanol, transfer to new tube; repeat wash twice more (30 s each). Air‑dry beads 5 min. Elute with 9 µL ddH₂O, incubate 5 min RT, magnetize, transfer supernatant to new tube.

steps.title: Reverse transcription
steps.instruction: In PCR tube combine: 8 µL ligated RNA, 1 µL 25 µM RT primer (AR17), 1 µL 10 mM dNTP mix, 3 µL ddH₂O. Heat 65 °C 2 min, ice. Prepare 7 µL extension mix: 4 µL 5× First‑strand buffer, 1 µL 0.1 M DTT, 1 µL ddH₂O, 1 µL SuperScript III. Add extension mix to annealed RNA, incubate 42 °C 1 h.

steps.title: cDNA cleanup: ExoSAP-IT and silane beads
steps.instruction: Add 3.5 µL ExoSAP‑IT, vortex, spin, incubate 37 °C 15 min. Add 1 µL 0.5 M EDTA, mix. Add 3 µL 1 M NaOH, mix, incubate 70 °C 12 min. Add 3 µL 1 M HCl, mix to neutralize. Prepare 10 µL MyONE silane beads per sample, magnetize, discard supernatant, wash once with 500 µL RLT buffer, resuspend in 93 µL RLT. Add beads to cDNA, mix; add 111.6 µL 95‑100 % ethanol, mix, incubate RT 5 min. Magnetize, discard supernatant. Wash beads with 1 mL 75 % ethanol, transfer to new tube; repeat wash twice more (30 s each). Air‑dry 5 min. Elute cDNA with 12.5 µL ddH₂O, incubate 5 min RT, magnetize, transfer supernatant.

steps.title: Second PAGE purification of cDNA
steps.instruction: Repeat the gel‑run procedure described in step 16 using a suitable acrylamide gel for cDNA (≈8 % acrylamide, 7 M urea). Stain with SYBR Gold, excise bands corresponding to full‑length cDNA, and perform gel extraction as in step 17.

steps.title: 3′ DNA linker ligation
steps.instruction: To 5 µL cDNA add 0.8 µL rand3Tr3 adapter (80 µM) and 1 µL 100 % DMSO. Heat 75 °C 2 min, ice ≥1 min. Prepare 12.8 µL ligation master mix per sample on ice: 2 µL 10× NEB RNA ligase buffer (with DTT), 0.2 µL 0.1 M ATP, 9 µL 50 % PEG 8000, 0.5 µL high‑concentration T4 RNA ligase, 1.1 µL ddH₂O. Add master mix to cDNA, then an additional 1 µL RNA ligase. Incubate 30 s at RT, 1,200 rpm on Thermomixer, then flick tube every hour for a few hours; overnight incubation at RT is recommended.

steps.title: Third RNA cleanup with MyONE silane beads
steps.instruction: Place 5 µL MyONE silane beads in 1.5 mL tube, magnetize, discard supernatant. Wash once with 500 µL RLT buffer, resuspend in 60 µL RLT. Add beads to ligation reaction, mix. Add 60 µL 95‑100 % ethanol, mix, incubate RT 5 min with occasional flicks. Magnetize, discard supernatant. Wash beads with 1 mL 75 % ethanol, transfer to new tube; repeat wash twice more (30 s each). Air‑dry 5 min. Elute DNA with 27 µL 10 mM Tris‑HCl pH 7.5, incubate 5 min RT, magnetize, transfer 25 µL eluate to new tube.

steps.title: qPCR quantification of cDNA
steps.instruction: Prepare 9 µL qPCR master mix per well: 5 µL SYBR Select Master Mix, 3.6 µL ddH₂O, 0.4 µL 10 µM D5/D7 primer mix. Add 1 µL 1:10 diluted cDNA to each well of a 384‑well plate, add master mix, mix on ice. Run qPCR (standard program). Determine Ct; use 3 cycles fewer than Ct of the diluted sample for final library PCR.

steps.title: PCR amplify library
steps.instruction: Prepare 35 µL PCR master mix per sample on ice: 25 µL 2× Q5 PCR master mix, 5 µL ddH₂O, 2.5 µL 20 µM primer D50x (barcode), 2.5 µL 20 µM primer D70x. Add 12.5 µL cDNA and 2.5 µL ddH₂O, mix. PCR program: 98 °C 30 s; 6 cycles of 98 °C 15 s → 68 °C 30 s → 72 °C 40 s; then 3 cycles at Ct‑3 (98 °C 15 s → 72 °C 60 s); finish 72 °C 1 min.

steps.title: AMPure XP bead cleanup of PCR product
steps.instruction: Resuspend AMPure XP beads thoroughly. Add 90 µL beads to each 50 µL PCR reaction, mix, incubate RT 10 min, flicking periodically. Magnetize, discard supernatant. Wash beads twice with 1 mL 75 % ethanol (30 s each). Air‑dry beads 5 min on magnet. Resuspend beads in 12 µL ddH₂O, incubate RT 5 min, magnetize, transfer 10 µL supernatant to new tube.

steps.title: Quantify library and submit for sequencing
steps.instruction: Assess library size and concentration on a Bioanalyzer. Submit library for Illumina NextSeq sequencing (single‑end 150 nt reads; NextSeq 550 used in development).
